summary: Stinnett called Netanyahu and hardliners 'guilty in plain sight of genocide of the Palestinian people' in August 2026 and said in September he would vote against continued U.S. funding to Israel until Netanyahu is replaced and Israel makes restitution. His statements explicitly affirm genocide but direct blame at Netanyahu and the current government rather than at Israel broadly, and the conditionality of his funding opposition leaves open a return to normal U.S.-Israel relations.
